decision: Full car = 'Infiniti QX80 QX80 Full Car.stl' (35M tris) decimated out of core to 4 mm (5.9M) for every shot; levelled with one rigid transform (tools/level.py, RANSAC ground plane, long axis -> Y, nose +Y) shared by every scan; prep car6.json is the canonical --like frame
why: Lessons: 25M-tri STLs OOM Blender, never re-normalise parts; the 3 mm car (9.8M) was OOM-killed in prep. Levelled scan measures 5.36 x 2.17 (mirrors) x 1.94 m, matches the QX80

decision: Registered part/state scans (tools/regcheck.py, raw frame): fender_inner 2.4 mm, hood_under 2.0, r_fender 1.9, r_skirt_dooropen 2.2, wing 2.6, side_vents 3.1, front_bumper_duct 7.2, exhaust_cover 2.4 mm median on overlap. Not registered (own bench frames, 0 % overlap): door mirror, front/rear caliper, T-spec bumper, NACA ducts, badge. Rear Bumper Inner sits mid-car (1 % overlap) -> excluded
why: Brief: check every part is registered to the full car; all prepped with --like car6.json, and verified by red-over-grey renders (check/reg*.png, parts.jpg)

decision: What the parts actually are (looked at each render): 'Fender Inner' = clean full right-front fender panel; 'Front Bumper Duct' = right bumper corner + left duct; 'Side Vents' = the two fender vents; 'Exhaust cover' = two rear exhaust trims; 'Wing Only' = roof spoiler; 'Hood Underside' = hood-open state; 'Right Side Skirt Door Open' = fragmentary side capture
why: Drive names don't say which file is a clean panel; the explode must use clean panels

decision: Hood opens on a fitted hinge: axis ~X at y=1.22 m z=1.27 m (prepped), 37.2 deg = the captured open hood (tools/hinge.py, median 4.7 mm). Hood part = state-scan hood panel + the car's own hood skin; base = car minus skin + the state scan's under-hood capture (tools/hood.py)
why: Brief: hood open where state scans allow; car skin in the part keeps the closed pose identical to the full car, and the opening reveals real captured structure instead of a hollow shell

decision: Door-open state not used for an animated door
why: Right Side Skirt Door Open render is fragments (sills, B-pillar bits, arches), no clean door panel to hinge

decision: Logo from team Drive IllumaestheticLogoColor-01.png (1cZJj521P88T_vC2YZDJVVUCctGyNoukR) -> remotion/public/illumaesthetic_logo.png

decision: Music = infiniti-qx80_track.mp3, the original track generated for this reel by the parent session (ElevenLabs via Higgsfield, grand cinematic strings). Measured (tools/music.py): 92.3 BPM, beat 0.650 s, grid phase 0.112 s; first sound 0.685 s -> music.start 0.66; loud to 37.8 s, -20 dB by 39.1 s, silent 39.5 s -> video ends at music 39.5 (38.84 s video)
why: Brief: use only this track, measure where it ends; generated tracks can end early (this one fades 37.8-39.5 within its 40.05 s file)

decision: Cuts on the 8-beat phrase accents from 0.762 s: 5.962, 11.162 (build steps up), 21.562 (the lift: +7 dB, explode separates), 31.962 (strongest flux, explode locks); in-between cuts on beats with low-band hits: 9.212, 13.762 (low 0.94), 18.962 (low 0.95); logo on 34.562
why: Lessons: cut on accents not just the grid; vary holds (2-8 beats); separation on the drop, lock on the heaviest hit

decision: Hood opens 14.41 -> 16.36 (beats 22-25, beat 22 is the strongest low-band hit before the lift)
why: Motion events land on hits too, not only cuts

decision: Structure: front 3/4 turntable (8 beats) -> rear 3/4 orbit (5) -> grille close-up (3) -> wheel close-up (4) -> hood opens (8) -> top-down (4) -> exploded view separate/hold/reassemble (20) -> logo (~7.5 to silence); 38.84 s
why: Brief: Temerario order; holds vary 3-20 beats; the long explode spans the lift-to-heaviest-hit section of the track

decision: Close-ups = grille/badge and right-front wheel
why: Full-car scan resolved both (grille fins, multi-spoke rim) at 4 mm; the calipers/mirror are bench scans not registered to the car, so no caliper insert

decision: Exploded layout stacks panels ABOVE the car (hood +1.45 m, vents +0.95, fender +0.85/+0.35 x, roof spoiler +0.7, bumper corner +0.45 up/+0.5 fwd, exhaust trims back 0.6); staggered 0.08 s; camera 8.4-8.8 m orbiting 35->68 deg
why: First test: hood left the top of the 9:16 frame and the side end cropped the nose; lessons: portrait stacking, keep parts off the lens

decision: Framing tightened after the 30 % check: turntable 6.3 -> 5.4 m, rear orbit 6.4 -> 5.6 m, top-down 8.4 -> 7.6 m at 30 mm; front 3/4 orbits toward the nose
why: Large SUV: brief says frame wider but keep it filling the 9:16 frame; first sheet read small

decision: No text, no HUD
why: Temerario style brief: the scan is the content

decision: shot.py: Cycles persistent data off whenever a shot has animated parts (s5 hood, s7 explode)

decision: s2 re-aimed at the rear: target y -0.3 -> -1.0, 5.6 -> 6.2 m

decision: Delivered v1: 38.80 s, cuts verified by frame diff on the target frames

decision: v2 request (user rule relayed from subaru-wrx-va, now in lessons.md): luma check, audio cut check, scene director. Luma scan of every final render folder: no dark frames, no frame-to-frame step > 3 luma (s7_explode 29.4-32.3, s5_hood 40-50)
why: Persistent-data light dropouts happened in WRX VA/Cappuccino/Civic 11; QX80 animated shots already rendered with persistent data off

decision: Audio cut check (tools/cutcheck.py, 1 ms RMS half-rise): +4, +110, -3, -73, -112, -107, +44 ms vs the nearest broadband onset. Kept the beat-grid cuts: 50 ms RMS steps (music t) at 18.95 / 21.55-21.60 (lift, -18 -> -10 dB) / 32.00 / 34.60 match the cuts at 18.962 / 21.562 / 31.962 lock / 34.562
why: Legato strings track with no kick: the broadband-onset metric locks onto neighbouring string attacks (8-12 onsets per second in the loud section), while the musical hits are loudness steps on the 0.650 s grid

decision: v2 order (scene-director, direction.md/director.md): N0 whole-car front-right orbit -> grille -> RF wheel+vent -> hood opens -> N1 RF corner: bumper corner, vents, fender, hood lift one per hit -> N2 rear: spoiler, exhaust trims -> N3 reassembly from high front-left, hood shuts on the 32.00 step, clean car -> fade -> small logo
why: User v2 brief (relayed): order by scan features, travel front->side->rear, section focus with one part per hit, no all-at-once wide explode, whole car in the opener, fade then small logo; front is the richest region (hood state + 4 parts) so it gets the 21.56 lift

decision: Dropped v1 s1, s2, s6, s7; reused s3_grille, s4_wheel (retimed via src_fps), s5_hood unchanged
why: s1/s2 cropped and repeated each other's view (ive director IoU 0.76); s6 rotating top-down showed nothing new and clipped the roof; s7 separated everything at once in a wide orbit

decision: Side Vents split by x sign (x_side_vent_r / _l) so each moves outward from its own fender; all part motions translate-only
why: Brief item 5: spin only when a scanned backside is worth showing - the part scans are outer skins

decision: Parts move toward the lens / outward a short way (0.25-0.45 m), hood lifts 0.9 m (only part with real data under it)
why: Brief item 6: no blank holes as the subject; a short translation keeps each part covering its own hole

decision: Fade: N3 eased to render-black (RGB 7,7,9) over render t 5.2-6.5 (music 33.262-34.562) on PNG copies (renders/final/N3_faded), then the 360 px logo card
